recommendation.reason: 515 expert-authored disaster tasks with gold trajectories and programmatic scoring; best model only 53.7% versus 80.5% gold oracle; code and data released.
risks: Release described as forthcoming; confirm data and tools are public
No repeated runs or error bars; run-to-run variance unknown
Frontier models cluster within about 3 points near 52-54%

release.quote: 2026/10/17, The data and perception checkpoints are released on [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Kingdrone-Junjue/DORA).

redistribution_questions: Can the gated Hugging Face task data and perception checkpoints be redistributed or baked into a container image?

tasks.quote: DORA (**D**isaster **O**perational **R**esponse **A**gent benchmark) includes 515 expert-authored tasks across 45 real-world disaster events of 10 types on 5 continents, paired with expert-verified, replayable gold trajectories totaling 3,500 tool-call steps

verifier.full_credit: a task scores the mean of its fields, a dimension (T1-T5) the mean of its tasks, and the DORA score the macro-average of the five dimensions
verifier.quote: Final answers are scored per field according to the task's ``eval_spec`` (scalar closeness, exact match, set F1, dict of scalars, ranking Kendall, point distance, polygon IoU); a task scores the mean of its fields, a dimension (T1-T5) the mean of its tasks, and the DORA score the macro-average of the five dimensions.

oracle.path: data/tasks/ (the ``trajectory`` field of each task JSON)
oracle.quote: Each task is a JSON record with the question, an `input_data` manifest (paths relative to `images/`), the expert tool plan, the executed gold trajectory, the final answer and its `eval_spec`.

network_or_api: agent model endpoints (Gemini, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI)
exceptions: perception checkpoints (~12.7 GB) are needed to run the agents; `--no-checkpoints` is enough to score runs with evaluate.py
`m.summarize` (a T5 report tool) used Claude Opus 5.5 instead of the default Gemini 3 Flash
runtime.quote: Python 3.11 on Linux, Windows or macOS; the perception tools want a CUDA GPU with 12 GB or more (they fall back to the CPU, slowly).
